mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 64 degrees, but be aware of the elevated air quality index of 52.

The city is currently recruiting for an Engineering Technician to oversee public works projects, and don't forget that utility rates for sewer and stormwater have recently increased to keep our systems self-supporting.

There is plenty to do in our community, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company taking place today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's happening tomorrow.
Regarding local safety, the police department reported that last Friday, an officer arrested a driver for an O W I after finding them unresponsive in their vehicle.
Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM today serving the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor. If you miss that, tomorrow features the Raspberry Cheesecake flavor.
